prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL pixel-art fighter animation source atlas editing the attached OWN Ren reference. EXACTLY FOUR separated figures in ONE horizontal row on a transparent canvas, large margins. NOT five. Right-facing character Ren, the same small chibi boy with cream dog hood, floppy red-brown ears, brown hair, teal eyes, red cape with teal inner side and cream trim, paw mitts, dark shorts, red sneakers. Preserve the reference character proportions, head and hood and sneaker size IDENTICALLY at all four poses; NO resizing a pose to equal height. FIRST figure: exact neutral standing ruler from the first attached figure. Remaining THREE figures: ground normal attack ONE, a forward JUMP DIVING HEADBUTT followed by a headstand landing to link into a capoeira kick, NOT a punch.
1 windup: feet grounded, crouched knees, torso loading forward, both bent arms tucked LOW behind the chest; hood and face upright, head exact same size as standing.
2 HIT: spring FORWARD to the RIGHT, BOTH feet visibly OFF ground and trailing behind, torso nearly horizontal tilted down-forward, lead with the cream dog forehead pointed right/down, BOTH paw arms pulled back along the sides below the hood, knees folded. Strong diagonal body axis and real forward momentum, NO hands punching. The cape trails LEFT BELOW shoulder level so it does not overlap the upper hood silhouette; dog hood must retain same width, ears, and scale. Don't shorten/enlarge feet or head.
3 transition: after the dive, FULL upside-down HEADSTAND, cream crown of dog hood touching the floor, torso and hips above head, BOTH arms curved down from shoulders with BOTH mitts supporting floor near the head, both legs bent over body gathering for the next kick. Keep the dog hood upside down with same dimensions (rotate the original proportions, do not make a tiny head). Two legs, two arms only. Cape drapes beside torso, never through floor, and stays above hood crown.
Same crisp dense pixelart texture and dark contour as OWN reference. Same palette. No labels, captions, effects, blur, ground line, extra figures. Each figure fully separated horizontally by broad transparent gutters. Standing ruler and all three motion drawings at ONE common magnification. Keep all figures inside image with clear transparent outer margins. Motion reference is anime breakdance, but ONLY this original OWN Ren design.
